fixed: Choosing which version to keep no longer asks about versions that look exactly the same, such as a choreographer added on two devices before they synced: one is kept for you, the same one on every device. Such choices already waiting are no longer listed.
A choice between versions of a record that sync had merged from two devices is now saved, instead of failing with "The saved peer change is no longer current" whichever version you picked.
added: The version comparison shows where a dance was imported from and its licence.

changed: An equal-updatedAt tie is raised for the user only when the versions' user-visible fields (syncUserVisibleFields / syncUserVisibleBody) differ, with merged-away ids resolved; otherwise the version with the lowest content hash is kept on every device. SyncMergeEngine.plan takes the alias map.
fixed: resolveConflicts accepts an offered version filed under the id it was merged into.
